description: The plot illustrates the training loss over steps for six different chemical language models trained on a 20M dataset. The x-axis is labeled "Step" and features a broken linear scale divided into two distinct segments: the first segment ranges from 0 to 80k with tick marks at intervals of 20k, and the second segment ranges from 420k to 440k with tick marks at intervals of 10k. The y-axis is labeled "Train Loss" and also utilizes a broken linear scale; its lower segment ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 with tick marks every 0.2, while its upper segment ranges from 0.75 to 0.85 with tick marks at 0.75 and 0.85. The plot contains six solid lines without markers, all of which exhibit high-frequency fluctuations throughout their trajectories. The red line represents "ChemBART Small 20M," starting at approximately 0.85 on the upper y-axis segment at step 0, sharply declining to roughly 0.25 near step 20k on the lower segment, gradually increasing to about 0.35 at step 80k, and ending near 0.4 at step 440k in the second x-axis segment. The blue line, "ChemBART Medium 20M," follows a similar trajectory, starting at 0.85, dropping to 0.25, rising to 0.35 at 80k, and ending near 0.4 at 440k. The green line, "ChemBERTa Small 20M," starts at 0.85, drops to a minimum of approximately 0.3 near 20k, rises to 0.4 at 80k, and ends at the highest value among the models, approximately 0.45, at 440k. The orange line, "ChemBERTa Medium 20M," begins at 0.85, declines to 0.28 near 20k, increases to 0.38 at 80k, and concludes near 0.4 at 440k. The purple line, "ChemLLaMA Small 20M," starts at 0.85, drops to 0.22 near 20k, rises to 0.32 at 80k, and finishes near 0.38 at 440k. Finally, the brown line, "ChemLLaMA Medium 20M," starts at 0.85, reaches a minimum of approximately 0.22 near 20k, increases to 0.3 at 80k, and ends near 0.38 at 440k.
